saw_lines: People don’t pick deodorant once. They replace it when the old stick runs out, and they stay with what works.
So the sale is won at refill time, when the buyer compares options and the offer tips the order.
Your site shows 350,000+ five star reviews, yet 0 of 27 ads carry that number. Put 350,000+ on every creative and open two ads with a review quote about odor protection.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 350,000+ five star reviews, yet 0 of 27 ads carry that number, so new buyers have no reason to trust the claim. Put 350,000+ on every creative and open two ads with a review quote about odor protection.
Your site runs a first order discount, yet 0 of 26 ads mention any offer. A new buyer has no reason to click today. Put the first order discount in line one of three new ads and on the creative.

Your site offers Subscribe and Save 25%, yet 0 of 27 ads mention a subscription. Deodorant runs out on a schedule, and no ad asks for the refill. Run two ads for past buyers with Subscribe and Save 25% as headline.
Your site shows prices from $4.00 to $55, yet 0 of 27 ads mention price. Buyers want the cost before they click, and without it the ad is a guess. Lead one ad with the price per stick, then test it.
